Reasoning: Operational commitment to improve regulatory compliance and border security.

Reasoning: Health and social welfare commitment to address a long-term developmental crisis.

Reasoning: Policy change to incentivize industry participation in skills development.

Concise description: Expansion of the National Dialogue process.
